## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector positivity but narrow leadership and major mega-cap divergences (NVDA/GOOGL/MSFT), so neither directional conviction nor clear rotation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy: XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND. Technology: NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND. Financials: V (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -3.52%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials: FCX (1W: -9.37% | 1M: -9.92%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND. Industrials: ETN (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -7.07%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.65% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.27% | 1M: -7.82%) RECOVERY, CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +10.07% | 1M: -19.92%) RECOVERY, TJX (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Growth/Momentum style.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: APD (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -13.24%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -7.07%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.37% | 1M: -9.92%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Materials and select Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.27% | 1M: -7.82%) RECOVERY, CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +10.07% | 1M: -19.92%) RECOVERY, CRM (1W: +8.60% | 1M: -3.75%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL) — tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but positive at the sector level; breadth is contributing to the market’s 9/11 reading. AAPL (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -0.73%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +11.80%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.41% | 1M: +17.04%) CORRECTION — leadership is concentrated and divergence is high.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious-positive: V (1W: +3.26% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND and pockets of strength offset uneven returns like JPM (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -3.52%) RECOVERY. Financials are contributing to breadth but growth/value mix is mixed.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive tone with idiosyncratic catalysts. LLY (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +13.02%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -4.45% | 1M: +10.78%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -4.01%) BELOW TREND — headlines are driving dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Growth/Momentum winners (NOW, CSCO, PANW) while reducing exposure to lagging Materials and beaten Industrials (FCX, NEM, ETN). Monitor mega-cap divergence (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT) and news-driven gaps (CRM negative, PFE bullish) before broad allocation shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, TJX (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +0.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: FCX (1W: -9.37% | 1M: -9.92%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -1.75%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +7.98%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND) and pockets of Technology. BEARISH: Materials (FCX, NEM BELOW TREND) and select Industrials (BA, ETN showing short-term weakness).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +11.80%) CORRECTION — watch for 1W follow-through below weekly lows to confirm deeper pullback. AAPL (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND — hold above recent support to keep the uptrend intact. XOM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +6.05%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly strength would reinforce Energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TJX (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +0.30%) (+60): raised FY guide — price ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) (+55): AI infra headlines — price ABOVE TREND, confirming accumulation. PFE (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -4.01%) (+60): vaccine data — bullish news but price BELOW TREND, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CRM (1W: +8.60% | 1M: -3.75%) (-50): downgrade/AI concerns — negative headlines diverge from 1W strength (RECOVERY), monitor for distribution. UNH (1W: -4.45% | 1M: +10.78%) (-50): headline-driven selling confirming CORRECTION. NEM (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -1.75%) (-50): cost concerns — price BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum style. NOW (1W: +18.67% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND and CSCO (1W: +12.25% | 1M: +27.48%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is narrow leadership and major mega-cap divergence (NVDA/GOOGL/MSFT) amplified by mixed news flow (CRM negative vs PFE bullish) — watch for trend confirmation before shifting beta.
